name: UWB ranging/communication board
description: Ultra-wideband transceiver (DW1000/DW3000 class) for ranging and short-range data with its antenna and precise clock.
critical_electrical_constraints: Wideband 50 ohm feed with an antenna rated for the channel
Crystal trim per the transceiver's calibration procedure
stackup_recommendations: 4 layers minimum for controlled impedance: RF on top over an unbroken ground on layer 2 with a known dielectric thickness
Document the dielectric thickness and Er used for the 50 ohm calculation; the fabricator's impedance service must confirm
placement_rules: Antenna at a board edge or corner with the keep-out the antenna datasheet prescribes; no copper, parts or tracks in the keep-out on any layer
Matching network components in a straight line between transceiver and antenna, pi-network footprints populated per the module/antenna datasheet
Crystal/TCXO within 5 mm of the transceiver, away from switching regulators
Switching regulators and digital buses as far from the RF section as the board allows
routing_rules: RF trace as a 50 ohm microstrip or grounded coplanar waveguide; width from the fabricator stackup, not a default
No vias on the RF trace; no stubs; gentle bends
Ground vias fence along coplanar RF lines at <= lambda/20 spacing
Reference ground under the RF trace must be unbroken from transceiver to antenna
copper_ground_requirements: Solid ground plane under the RF section on the layer directly below
Via stitching around the RF section perimeter
No copper pour inside the antenna keep-out on any layer
thermal_considerations: Power amplifiers: exposed pad to ground plane with a thermal via array per the PA datasheet
emi_emc_considerations: Keep harmonics of switching regulators out of the RF band: choose frequency or add LC filtering on the PA supply
Shield can footprint when the product requires it; digital signals away from the antenna
protection_requirements: ESD on the antenna port where an external antenna connector is exposed (RF-rated TVS or shunt inductor as the transceiver datasheet allows)
verification_requirements: RF trace width and gap verified against the fabricator impedance calculator (value recorded in the design profile)
Antenna keep-out checked as a DRC keep-out on every layer
Regulatory pre-check: module certification and band plan recorded
Netlist and connectivity verification as for any board
manufacturing_constraints: Controlled-impedance order with the stackup stated; 4-layer JLCPCB stackup JLC04161H-7628 or equivalent recorded in the profile
No HASL on RF connectors' fine-pitch pads; ENIG preferred
unsupported_conditions: Narrow-band antenna on a UWB port
